g.text: St. Peter’s hospital is located at 88 Maplewood Avenue, Hamilton. On the main level, there are wheelchair accessible entrances, elevators, an information desk, gift shop,
cafeteria, and accessible washrooms. Accessible parking spaces are available in the rear parking lot, near the walkway toward the hospital courtyard. For information about
specific locations, please call your clinic’s extension or the main hospital switchboard at 905.521.2100. When you arrive, please visit the information desk in the main lobby if
